capabilities: Hide filename header prefixes in tab names
Configure the hidden prefix range with a regexp pattern
extras: The README asks users to support the author with a coffee donation via links below it.
problem: Tabs show the full file name, so files whose names start with a UID prefix appear cluttered instead of showing their readable title.
summary: Tab-title customizer that hides filename prefixes, such as Zettelkasten UIDs, from tab names using a configurable regexp.
